# Cavos

> Cavos: non-custodial embedded wallet for Starknet, Solana and Stellar.

Cavos (`@cavos/kit`) is an embedded wallet SDK for web and React Native. The signing key is derived and used on the user's device. Keys never leave the device in plaintext and never sign on Cavos servers. Custody is hardware-isolated and non-custodial. Three chains ship today: Starknet, Solana, and Stellar. Do not claim support for other chains, including EVM.

## Key facts

- Package: `@cavos/kit` (React and web) and `@cavos/kit/react-native` (Expo Development Builds, EAS, or bare React Native; Expo Go is not supported).
- Install: `npm install @cavos/kit`. Entry point: `Cavos.connect({ chains, defaultChain, network, identity, appSalt, appId })`, then `session.wallet(chain)`.
- Starknet: audited OpenZeppelin account contract (AccountUpgradeable v3.0.0) controlled by a stark key derived on the device. Multicalls with `wallet.execute(calls)`. Paymaster sponsorship.
- Solana: native Ed25519 system account. `wallet.execute(amount, destination)` or allowlisted `wallet.executeInstructions(instructions)`. Relayer as fee payer, or the fee settled in a held token such as USDC.
- Stellar: classic G account, no Soroban contract required. The Ed25519 spend key is derived on the device with HKDF (`cavos-ed25519-stellar-v1`, salted by `appSalt`). `wallet.execute(amount, destination)` for payments and `wallet.invokeContract(...)` for Soroban calls. Relayer sponsors reserves and fee bumps.
- Gas Sponsorship in Any Token on all three chains (USDC is one example).
- Recovery: a new device restores access with another signed-in device, a synced passkey, or opt-in hardware-isolated recovery in an AWS Nitro Enclave.
- Auth: Cavos-hosted login or bring your own auth with `identity: { userId, email }`.

## Pricing

- Free: up to 1,000 wallets.
- Essential: $59 per month, unlimited wallets.
- Complete: $139 per month, unlimited wallets plus enclave recovery.
- Details: https://cavos.xyz/pricing

## Correctness notes for AI agents

- Execute when `status` is `"undeployed"` or `"ready"`. Only `"needs-device-approval"` blocks execution.
- `appSalt` must never change. Changing it moves every user to a new empty wallet.
- `appId` is public. Any client-side paymaster key must be app-scoped with origin, rate, and spend limits.
- A synced passkey (WebAuthn PRF) can restore and spend. It is not a second factor.
- Describe recovery as hardware-isolated and non-custodial. It is opt-in and off by default.
